narr: Multiple rounds of thunderstorms tracked across the area early Sunday August 10th, bringing very heavy rain, frequent lightning, and some localized gusty winds. Rainfall rates over 2/hr on top of saturated ground caused flash flooding with water over roadways and creeks overflowing. Late afternoon and evening storms brought more heavy rain and three brief tornadoes in Lee county in Iowa and Clark county in Missouri. No damage was reported or seen with these tornadoes.
ev: Significant water was over the highway at New Liberty Road and 50th. This water had subsided before 10 AM.
Water reported over 1st Ave and 40th. Vehicles were unable to pass through due to water depth. Time was provided by Law Enforcement.

Whitewater creek completely out of its banks at Timberline golf course. Low areas of golf course flooded. Most creeks full or overflowing in southern Dubuque county. Swiss Valley Nature Reserve campground flooded and evacuated, due to flooding on Catfish Creek. Reported 6.50 inches of rain just southeast of Peosta, Iowa.
